item.title: The Intimate Path of Torah: HaMaspik LeOvdei HaShem, Chapter 1
item.description:
Two ways to serve HaShem: the path of the people, keeping every commandment, and the inner path of the individual who seeks closeness. Chapter 1 of HaMaspik LeOvdei HaShem contrasts the saddik and the hasid, the revealed and the hidden, and the path that has no end.

item.description:

item.title: Compassion and Generosity: HaMaspik LeOvdei HaShem, Chapters 4-5
item.description:

item.title: When Greatness Falls: Arrogance in Tanakh | HaMaspik LeOvdei HaShem, Chapter 7 Part 2
item.description:

item.title: Nothing to Be Arrogant About: The Intellectual Case for Humility | HaMaspik Ch 7 Pt 4
item.description:
Is there anything to be proud of? HaMaspik LeOvdei HaShem 7 completes the intellectual case for humility: wisdom shows how much more there is, cosmic comparison dissolves pride, religious arrogance is the most dangerous kind, the analysis must never become self-loathing, and humility before HaShem in the bowings of the Amidah.

item.title: When Humility Isn't Required: The Limits of Anavah | HaMaspik LeOvdei HaShem, Chapter 7 Part 5
item.description:
Is humility ever not required? The close of HaMaspik LeOvdei HaShem 7: humility is accurate self-knowledge, never self-debasement; simple clothes but not filthy ones, honouring those who deserve it, leaders suspending outward humility but never the inner kind, everyday practices, and the rewards of humility.

item.title: What is Bitahon? Trust, Reliance & Faith | HaMaspik LeOvdei HaShem, Chapter 8 Part 1

item.title: The Correct Attitude to Bitahon: Trust Hashem, Use the Means | HaMaspik LeOvdei HaShem Ch 8 Pt 2
